mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, we are looking at 30 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park under a Full Moon. We will see an overnight low of 29 degrees with no rain in the forecast.
City officials remind us that property tax bills will arrive by December 15. You can pay your bills online through the city website or visit the City Center drop box, which is open 24 hours a day.

There is plenty to do with trivia happening today at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can catch live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow or attend the 50th anniversary celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company on Thursday.
In a notable incident from November 8, police arrested a driver for O W I after their vehicle struck a pole and caught fire on South Main Street.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the delicious Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The store is currently open but will be closing in 55 minutes, so make sure to get there soon.
